answer_1.quote: We aim to generate summaries with specified levels of readability, given an input document... We study three methods to control the readability of generated summaries.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the readability with the FRE, GFI and CLI metrics... We use BertScore (BS) and the F1 measure of ROUGE-L (RG-L) for evaluating the summary quality; and FactCC and UniEval for faithfulness assessment.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations to determine how readable and informative the CNN/DM generated summaries are, using Amazon Mechanical Turk... We ask annotators to select the most readable and the least readable summaries among three displayed, and similarly for informativeness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select the most and least readable summary among three, and the most and least informative summary among three.
